Good to know

A few useful answers.
Can we try Northstar before paying?

Yes. The Free plan includes the core planning tools and does not require a card.

Can I invite my whole team?

You can invite teammates to a shared workspace and decide together when to move to Team.

Can I leave whenever I want?

Yes. You can cancel a paid plan at any time, and your workspace stays available through the billing period.
